row.name: integration_app_github_settings_view
row.definition: select "integration_id", "app_id", CASE WHEN "gitgazer"."integration_app_github_settings"."integration_id" = ANY ((SELECT github.integration_ids('admin'))::uuid[]) THEN "secret" END as "secret", "org_sync_default_role" from "gitgazer"."integration_app_github_settings" where "gitgazer"."integration_app_github_settings"."integration_id" = ANY ((SELECT github.integration_ids('viewer'))::uuid[])

row.name: integration_invitations_view
row.definition: select "integration_id", "id", CASE WHEN "gitgazer"."integration_invitations"."integration_id" = ANY ((SELECT github.integration_ids('admin'))::uuid[]) THEN "email" END as "email", "role", "invited_by", "invitee_id", CASE WHEN "gitgazer"."integration_invitations"."integration_id" = ANY ((SELECT github.integration_ids('admin'))::uuid[]) THEN "invite_token" END as "invite_token", "status", "created_at", "expires_at" from "gitgazer"."integration_invitations" where (("gitgazer"."integration_invitations"."status" <> 'accepted') and ("gitgazer"."integration_invitations"."integration_id" = ANY ((SELECT github.integration_ids('member'))::uuid[])))

row.name: slack_workspaces_view
row.definition: select "team_id", "team_name", "bot_user_id", CASE WHEN "gitgazer"."slack_workspaces"."installed_by" in (select "user_id" from "github"."user-assignments" where "github"."user-assignments"."integration_id" = ANY ((SELECT github.integration_ids('viewer'))::uuid[])) THEN "installed_by" END as "installed_by", "installed_at", "disconnected_at" from "gitgazer"."slack_workspaces" where "gitgazer"."slack_workspaces"."team_id" in (select "team_id" from "gitgazer"."integration_app_slack_settings" where "gitgazer"."integration_app_slack_settings"."integration_id" = ANY ((SELECT github.integration_ids('viewer'))::uuid[]))

row.name: users_view
row.definition: select "id", CASE WHEN "gitgazer"."users"."id" in (select "user_id" from "github"."user-assignments" where "github"."user-assignments"."integration_id" = ANY ((SELECT github.integration_ids('admin'))::uuid[])) THEN "email" END as "email", "name", "picture", "github_login", "last_active_at" from "gitgazer"."users" where "gitgazer"."users"."id" in (select "user_id" from "github"."user-assignments" where "github"."user-assignments"."integration_id" = ANY ((SELECT github.integration_ids('viewer'))::uuid[]))

row.name: webhook_handle_details_view
row.definition: select "integration_id", "handle_id", CASE WHEN "gitgazer"."webhook_handle_details"."integration_id" = ANY ((SELECT github.integration_ids('admin'))::uuid[]) THEN "url" END as "url" from "gitgazer"."webhook_handle_details" where "gitgazer"."webhook_handle_details"."integration_id" = ANY ((SELECT github.integration_ids('viewer'))::uuid[])
